tool_schemas.name: get_service_status
tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy: rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary:
checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate was 0.18). v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production. The most recent production release that was healthy is v2.3.0, so I rolled back to it.

Actions taken:
1. Checked deployment history. v2.3.0 was healthy in production. v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy in staging only.
2. Ran rollback to v2.3.0. The first attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error (partial_failure), leaving the service mixed: us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1.
3. Retried the rollback to v2.3.0. It completed in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

Current state: v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy=true, error_rate 0.002 (down from 0.18).

Follow-up: investigate the orchestrator partial failure on the first rollback attempt. Investigate the v2.3.1 health failure before any redeploy. v2.3.1 needs change-manager approval for production because it has never been healthy there.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three regions, and the service is healthy again. The error rate dropped from 0.18 to 0.002.

- **Target version:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production, and v2.3.1-rc was only deployed to staging.
- **Rollback:** The first attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, which left the regions mixed (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1). I retried the same rollback, and it completed in us-east, us-west and eu-west.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0002 for checkout-api. The first attempt to create it timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key. The incident is open and on-call has been paged. Its summary covers the steps above.

Follow-ups:
- Investigate why the first rollback attempt halted partway. The orchestrator may need attention.
- Investigate the v2.3.1 health failures before any redeploy. v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production, so deploying it again requires change-manager approval.
